description: This Java source file defines the SubSupervisor class, an Akka actor responsible for supervising subscription-related actors in a pub/sub system. It manages child actors for subscriptions and acknowledgements, handles actor lifecycle events, and coordinates data updates via distributed data (DData).

classes.name: SubSupervisor
classes.description: An Akka actor class supervising subscription and acknowledgement actors, managing distributed data updates, and handling actor lifecycle events.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props for SubSupervisor with specified message class, topic extractor, and data references.

methods.name: createPubSubBehavior
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling behavior using ReceiveBuilder, managing subscription and acknowledgement messages.

methods.name: onChildFailure
methods.description: Handles failure of child actors, logs error, and resets updater reference.

methods.name: startChildren
methods.description: Initializes child actors for subscriber, updater, and optionally acknowledgements updater.

methods.name: subscriberTerminated
methods.description: Handles termination of subscriber actor, removing it from distributed data.

methods.name: isUpdaterAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the updater actor reference is non-null.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request message to the updater actor.

methods.name: isAcksUpdaterAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgements updater actor reference is non-null.

methods.name: declareAckLabels
methods.description: Sends a declare acknowledgement labels message to the acknowledgements updater.

methods.name: updaterUnavailable
methods.description: Handles scenario when the updater actor is unavailable, logs error, and replies with exception.

methods.name: acksUpdaterUnavailable
methods.description: Handles scenario when the acknowledgements updater is unavailable, logs error, and replies with exception.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgement label subscription, delegating to acknowledgements updater if available.
